reference: ASD-STE100 Issue 9; existing official local reference and project terminology
review: Language and meaning review; formulas, identifiers, numbers, code, links and conditions retained. Not external certification.

limits: The checker covers selected structural rules only.
Review vocabulary, approved meanings, grammar, technical terms, and technical accuracy manually.
Word counts use a limited unit list. Review proper names, abbreviations, labels, and complex Markdown.
A protected-content match does not prove that the meaning stayed the same.
